candidates.label: Canaux industriels
candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Victoria 3 PRODUCTION METHOD (PM) icon, batch 10 CANALS, PREVIEW ONLY.
Make ONE square high-resolution PNG with GENUINE transparent alpha background and openings. This is a SMALL FLAT GAME PICTOGRAM, NOT a realistic picture, painting, scene or technical plan.
Input 1 is ONLY a reference for native PM broad shapes and colour families: use its RED family, not its yellow or green. Input 2 is ONLY the approved subtle matte grain and simple flat graphic style: translate that style to RED, never copy its furnace subject or beige colour. Do NOT copy reference labels, text, UI panels or layout.
Colour: all visible components of the icon are in ONE coherent MUTED RED family, pale dusty salmon at top grading to darker muted brick red at bottom, dark muted burgundy graphic outlines, not saturated orange. ONE GLOBAL vertical GRAPHIC colour gradient and subtle fine MATTE grain. Flat TWO-DIMENSIONAL opaque fills. No object lighting, local shaded volume, bevel, extrusion, relief, 3D, metallic sheen, cast shadows or photo texture.
Composition: centered compact nearly square silhouette with generous transparent margins; bold components and broad clear openings read at 32px. At most TWO principal symbols; connected parts of one apparatus count as that apparatus.
Avoid: text, letter, number, arrow, label, watermark, logo, frame, badge, enclosing circle, landscape, trees, factories, people, tow horse, multiple boats, sailing ship, sails, steamship, smokestack, diesel motor, electrical controls, bridge, modern cranes, locks shaped like padlocks, blue water, white water, detailed brickwork, many tiny seams or realistic perspective.
Primary request: INDUSTRIAL CANALS. Exactly TWO main graphic symbols in one tightly connected composition: ONE traditional WOODEN CANAL LOCK GATE, and ONE small simple LOW FREIGHT BARGE in front of its lower part. The wooden gate dominates the top half: a broad upright rectangle with only 3 or 4 wide slats, ONE thick diagonal bracing beam and a long stout horizontal manual BALANCE BEAM along the top extending a little sideways. Wood is conveyed only by broad structure, no grain lines. The barge sits at the bottom foreground and is one low broad hull in SIMPLE FLAT SIDE ELEVATION, slightly tapered bow, a small open rectangular cargo well containing 2-3 large plain cargo shapes integral to this one barge; no mast or ornate cabin. ONE short bold wave stroke immediately beneath hull symbolises canal water as part of the same glyph, red not blue. Keep the barge's full unmistakable low hull visible, not obscured by the gate. Gate and boat together are a compact readable PM emblem, not a miniature landscape. No stone piers or machinery for this first stage.

Each pier has only 2-3 broad horizontal masonry joints; thick cap blocks. The gates have wide slats and stout braces, two clearly separated upper manual balance beams, ONE small crank with a large plain winding wheel attached to the side pier as part of this lock apparatus, no free-standing gears. Keep the pair of leaves and two piers readable as ONE reinforced lock, not a bridge or building. In the low foreground place the ONE barge in simple flat SIDE ELEVATION with broad hull and small cargo well, overlapping only the foot of the piers, never hiding the gates. ONE short bold red wave stroke below hull symbolises canal water. The double gates, stone piers and integral crank visibly distinguish this stage from the basic single wooden lock gate.
